kjv: the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ
note: TR "tou theou kai patros kai tou Christou" is a conflation; P46, B read "tou theou, Christou" ("God's mystery, Christ"). One of the most varied readings in the NT.

kjv: the body of the sins of the flesh
note: TR adds "ton hamartion"; absent from Sinaiticus*, A, B, C, D*, F, G.

kjv: intruding into those things which he hath not seen
mine: going on in detail about visions
note: TR adds "me" (not), reversing the sense; the early text (P46, Sinaiticus*, A, B, D*) has "ha heoraken", what he has seen, i.e. visionary experiences.
